TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS FOR VARIOUS CHEMICALS: 1. NITRIC ACID 69-70%: Nitric Acid must be as per IS 264: 2005 Chemically Pure (16000 Kgs) Quantity : 16000 kgs instead of 16000 liters as mention in the Catalogue i. The composition details are as follows: a. Total acidity (as HN03): Minimum 65.0 to Maximum 69.5 percent by mass or above

ii. Acceptance Criteria: a. The material shall be not darker than pale brown in colour and shall be free from sediment and other visi ble impurities or the material shall be clear and almost colourless, free from sediment and other visible im purities. b. The material shall be packed in HDPE acid carboys of minimum 30 Kg to Maximum 50 Kg capacity. c. The containers / carboys shall be fitted with leak-tight stoppers. d. The containers and also the packages, where possible, shall be suitably marked in red letters, no less tha n 25 mm high, showing: § Name of material; § Manufacturer’s name and recognized trade mark, if any; § Grade and mass of the material; § Year of manufacture § They shall prominently display the cautionary notice: ‘CORROSIVE, HANDLE WITH CARE’ § The containers may also be marked with the Standard Mark 2. IRON POWDER REAGENT GRADE: ( 1600 Kgs) i. Total elemental iron present in the powder must be minimum 93% and other technical specifications mu st be as per IS 1612. ii. Acceptance Criteria: a. Marking - The packages shall be securely closed and legibly and indelibly marked with the following information: § Name of the material and its sieve analysis. § Manufacturer’s name and/or his recognized trade-mark, if any; § Mass of the material in the package; § Year of packing; § Identification in code or otherwise to enable the batch of manufacture to be traced from record 3. POTASSIUM NITRATE (AR): (10 Kgs) i. Potassium nitrate ( as KNO3 ), percent by mass, Min 99.5% as per IS 301 ii. Acceptance Criteria: a. Packing: The material shall be packed in sound, clean and dry packages which shall ensure safe transport ation and complete freedom from accidental contamination. The required packing size must be 500 g cont ainer. b. Marking: The packages shall be legibly marked with the following information: § Name and grade of the material; § Tare and net mass;

§ Name of the manufacturer and/or his recognized trade-mark, if any; § Date of manufacture; and § Lt number in code or otherwise to enable the batch of manufacture to be traced from records. II. OTHER TERMS & CONDITIONS: i. Supplier shall supply the materials to IG Mint, Hyderabad Stores and no additional charges to be allowe d for the same. ii. Supplier must arrange for unloading of the chemicals at IGMH Stores without any extra charges as no m anpower shall be provided by IGMH for the same. iii. Supplier must submit Test Certificates from any NABL accredited laboratory or Manufacturer in support o f the composition details of the chemical. iv. Supplier must submit Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) along with the supply of the materials. B) Eligibility: a. For MSE/Start-up firm: Capability - Equipment &Manufacturing Facilities: The bidder firm should have ca pability to manufacture and supply of tendered item. b. For other firm - Experience and past performance: The bidder firm may be Manufacturer/ Proven supple r/ Authorized dealer or distributor of tendered item or bidder may participate with manufacturing authori zation form (issued by manufacturer of tendered item). c. The bidder has to submit the duly sign and seal of the bid document for token of acceptance of all the t erms and condition of the Bid. C) Payment Terms: Payment shall be made as per delivery schedule; within 30 days from the acceptance of material by competent authority of IGMH and submission of bill by the supplier. D) Shelf Life: The shelf life is 3 Months from the date of Supply of Chemicals .
